01 / COMPUTER VISION

Face Recognition

PyTorchResNet-18ArcFace512-D
OVERVIEW

A face-recognition pipeline built to study how identity embeddings behave when a

model is trained and fine-tuned rather than treated as a black-box pretrained system.

512embedding dimensions
128training image size
ArcFacemetric-learning objective
Real-timewebcam validation
APPROACH

Experiments included MobileFaceNet and ResNet-18 backbones, ArcFace

margins/scales, scratch training and fine-tuning. Similarity was

evaluated using same-person and different-person embedding pairs.

ENGINEERING CHALLENGE

Understanding embedding collapse, threshold selection and the gap

between clean evaluation images and noisy webcam frames.

TAKEAWAY

Recognition quality depends on the complete pipeline: alignment, augmentation,
embedding geometry, training stability and evaluation—not only backbone size.

02 / COMPUTER VISION

Face Detection

WiderFaceFPNAnchors640px
OVERVIEW

A face detector designed from scratch for selfies, classroom/group

photographs and scenes containing many small-to-medium faces.

ARCHITECTURE

The detector uses a custom convolutional backbone followed by a

top-down feature pyramid. P3, P4 and P5 provide different spatial

resolutions so the detector can address faces at multiple scales.

3FPN detection levels
640letterboxed input
15–30target group-photo faces
CPUvalidation target
ANCHOR DESIGN

Scale-specific anchors were assigned to P3/P4/P5 so small

faces are represented at higher-resolution feature maps.

ENGINEERING FOCUS

Robustness to dark faces, very large faces, padding/cropping and real webcam

input were treated as practical failure cases.

03 / AUDIO ML

Voice Analysis

MFCCEMDWav2Vec2ASTSVM
OVERVIEW

A speech-pathology experimentation pipeline combining classical

acoustic features, empirical mode decomposition and pretrained

representation models with conventional machine-learning classifiers.

FEATURE PIPELINE

Experiments covered MFCCs, IMF-derived signal characteristics, pitch, jitter and

shimmer, alongside learned representations from audio transformer models.

MFCCspectral features
EMDnon-stationary analysis
SVMtuned classifier
RFbaseline comparison
CLASSIFICATION

Experiments covered vocal conditions including polyp, cyst and

laryngitis datasets, comparing feature families and classifiers.

RESULTS

Reported experiments reached approximately 89.9% accuracy on

the cyst dataset with an SVM configuration, while other datasets varied with feature/classifier choices.

04 / REAL-TIME GRAPHICS

Three.js Portfolio

Three.jsWebGLBlenderHTMLMesh
OVERVIEW

This portfolio is itself an engineering project: a 3D environment

built around a physical iPad-like interface that displays the portfolio

as HTML inside the scene.

SYSTEM

Blender provides the environment and GLB assets. Three.js handles the

scene, camera and interaction. HTMLMesh provides the portfolio surface,

while custom environment logic controls the day/night state.

GLBBlender scene assets
HTMLMesh3D portfolio surface
DAY/NIGHTenvironment transition
Particlesleaves + fireflies
ENVIRONMENT

Separate day/night spheres, controlled lighting, HDRI

transitions, falling leaves, fireflies and subtle wind movement

create a living scene.

PERFORMANCE

The system favors lightweight procedural effects and avoids

unnecessary geometry or continuously expensive effects so the

scene remains suitable for constrained hardware.

05 / PROCEDURAL GENERATION

Kolam Generator

PythonGeometryProcedural
OVERVIEW

A Python-based generative project exploring how structured visual

patterns can be produced algorithmically rather than drawn manually.

IDEA

The generator treats a kolam as geometry and rules: points establish

structure while curves and transformations build a continuous,

symmetric-looking pattern.

RULESprocedural construction
CURVEScontinuous geometry
SYMMETRYstructured variation
PYTHONgeneration pipeline
WHY IT MATTERS

The project is an example of translating a visual design language

into explicit computational rules.

FOCUS

Procedural generation, geometric reasoning and turning

deterministic rules into varied visual outputs.
